name: Incomplete scene configuration prevents car tracking
description: The analysis action stays unavailable until the video movement, stop line, direction, and associated signal are configured and saved.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Media Traffic application.
Upload the synthetic demo video at example/demo-traffic-video/source.mp4.
Open the scene configuration for the uploaded video.
In the scene configuration actions, verify that Start traffic analysis is disabled while required movement and signal fields are incomplete.
Verify the saved configuration is identified in the scene configuration panel and Start traffic analysis is enabled.
